difficulty_reason: Choose quasi-affine presentations T_1 -> V, T' -> Y'; the affine pieces A^{n'}_{T_1 x_V V'} and A^{n_1}_{V' x_{Y'} T'} are identified through the triple, so lemma-glueing-affines produces T -> X with the two A^n-bundles as base changes; the induced maps to V and Y' satisfy the presentation property; repeat on the fibre-product triple to get W -> T x_X T, prove by fully faithfulness that its base changes are the two projections, transport flat-fp-closed-immersion via lemma-glueing-affines-etale, check the equivalence-relation axioms componentwise after base change ('details omitted', obvious componentwise), take the Bootstrap quotient Y = T/W, and descend the closed diagonal to separatedness.

compared.note: Quasi-affine level of the BL glueing; the omitted check is componentwise-tautological after base change.
